# SQLAlchemy 2.1.0's sdist declares duplicate normalized optional-dependency
# names (including mssql-pymssql), so uv rejects its build metadata before
# wheel tests start. Observed in Full CI run 36051534826 with uv 0.12.18.
# Exclude only that release; this constrains CI installation, not wheel metadata.
sqlalchemy!=2.1.0

# googleapis-common-protos 1.75.4 registers operations_proto.proto instead of
# operations.proto, which google-vizier 0.1.21 requires. Full CI 36074952226
# failed 18 Sweeper tests on import; 1.75.1 through 1.75.3 pass the same probe.
# Exclude only the observed incompatible release from CI installation.
googleapis-common-protos!=1.75.4
